title: Understand Hot, Warm, Cold, Frozen, and Thawed Data
objectives: Understand Hot, Warm, Cold, Frozen, and Thawed Data
Verify the active operational state and explain the evidence.

tasks.instruction: Create lifecycle_logs with maxHotIdleSecs=10, maxWarmDBCount=1, retention=60 seconds and coldToFrozenDir=/archive/lifecycle_logs.
Ingest two separate batches at least one clock tick apart. Inspect hot, warm and cold states in Settings → Indexes or | dbinspect index=lifecycle_logs. Advance time past retention.

In Settings → Indexes, restore one archived bucket to thawed storage. Verify one frozen archive remains and exactly one event is searchable. This restore is a bounded practice workflow, not a native Splunk command.

hints: Inspect effective configuration and the delivery error before changing a setting.
Creating an index does not add events. Verify the destination, activation and search window independently.

checks.label: lifecycle_logs is active on idx01 with the required settings
checks.name: lifecycle_logs

checks.label: Search independently confirms the indexed result

questions.prompt: Is frozen data searchable before an explicit thaw (yes/no)?

feedback.success: Completion requires active configuration, verified search results and correct evidence answers.
feedback.incomplete: Inspect failed outcomes. Disk changes require activation; data must be ingested explicitly.
